organizations.publicNote: Columbia record-label imprint used for the French DF series, including DF 1606, DF 1610 and DF 1622. Columbia Graphophone was the associated corporate body, not an alternative form of the label name.

sources.shortCitation: YouTube, “Tino Rossi 1934 - On n’aime qu’une fois (You Love Only Once)”
sources.fullCitation: 240252, uploader. “Tino Rossi 1934 - On n’aime qu’une fois (You Love Only Once).” YouTube audio reference, uploaded 22 December 2020.
sources.title: Tino Rossi 1934 - On n’aime qu’une fois (You Love Only Once) — YouTube
sources.researchNote: The uploader identifies Tino Rossi with Orchestre de Tango Rafaelo and Columbia 1934. BnF independently catalogues this title with the same singer and orchestra on Columbia DF 1622, but the upload does not show the disc label or catalogue number; it is therefore retained as access evidence rather than treated as a visual verification of the pressing.

sources.shortCitation: BnF, Tino Rossi, Les nuits moscovites / On n’aime qu’une fois, Columbia DF 1622
sources.fullCitation: Tino Rossi, voice, with Orchestre de Tango Rafaelo. “Les nuits moscovites,” sung waltz, and “On n’aime qu’une fois,” sung tango, from Les nuits moscovites; music by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann. Columbia DF 1622, matrices CL 5068 and CL 5093. One 25 cm 78 rpm disc. Bibliothèque nationale de France, Catalogue général, notice FRBNF37826068, ARK ark:/12148/cb378260686.
sources.title: Tino Rossi — Les nuits moscovites / On n’aime qu’une fois (Columbia DF 1622)
sources.creator: Tino Rossi; Orchestre de Tango Rafaelo
sources.repository: Bibliothèque nationale de France / Catalogue général
sources.researchNote: The BnF catalogue dates the disc only as “19..”. The supplied date [1934] follows the film’s release year and is stated as supplied rather than transcribed. The catalogue lists matrices CL 5068 and CL 5093 but does not assign each matrix to a title in the displayed metadata, so no side-level matrix assignment is inferred here.
